name: Agathelos the Raging
summary: Agathelos the Raging is a colossal armored boar penned within the thorned tunnels of Razorfen Kraul. To the quilboar, whose god and progenitor is the great boar Agamaggan, a beast of his size carries considerable spiritual significance, and he grows even more fearsome when enraged. His sheer mass and strength make him one of the most dangerous beasts lurking under the southern Barrens.

sections.title: Avatars of the Great Boar
sections.body: The god and progenitor of the quilboar is Agamaggan, a titanic boar. A beast the size of Agathelos—standing roughly twice as tall as a Barrens thunder lizard—therefore carries considerable spiritual significance among the Razorfen tribes.

sections.title: Kept in Chains
sections.body: The quilboar do not let Agathelos roam loose within the Kraul. He is kept in a short, dead-end tunnel behind a field maintained by several quilboar guards. Should intruders break past the barrier, they face a raging beast that grows even bigger and more terrifying when enraged.

faq.answer: Agathelos is a naturally colossal armored boar, roughly twice the size of a common thunder lizard, and he grows even bigger when enraged. To the quilboar, whose god and progenitor Agamaggan was a titanic boar, a beast of his size carries considerable spiritual significance.

faq.q: Why do the quilboar keep him locked behind a barrier?
faq.answer: The quilboar keep Agathelos penned in a short tunnel behind a field maintained by several of their guards, so the monstrous, raging boar cannot roam the Kraul freely.

faq.q: What is his connection to Agamaggan?
faq.answer: Agamaggan is the great boar Ancient and progenitor of the quilboar race. Because of this ancestry, a gigantic boar like Agathelos carries considerable spiritual significance for the quilboar.
Agathelos is a beast, not a creation. He is kept by the Death's Head quilboar of Razorfen Kraul, who pen him in a guarded tunnel deep within the thorns.
No. Agathelos is an elite, heavily armored monster, far too dangerous to be brought under a hunter's control.

angles.text: A hunter can appreciate the sheer predatory bulk of Agathelos, though his endless rage makes him a beast to be slain rather than tamed.
Druids hold Agamaggan in high esteem as one of the great Ancients who fell during the War of the Ancients; seeing one of his colossal kin penned and raging in the Kraul is a grim sight.
The earth-attuned tauren know the legends of Agamaggan well, recognizing that the quilboar's corruption of his kindred beasts is another sign of the rot infesting the Barrens.
